title: Teenager, 17, with stomach pains hoisted by Coast Guard aircrew off La Push beach
description:
A Coast Guard aircrew hoists a teenager off of Third Beach near La Push, Washington, Aug. 20, 2017 after he was reportedly suffering from abdominal pain and was shaking, sweating, nauseous and unable to communicate.

The MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew from Air Station Port Angeles safely hoisted the 17-year-old and transported him to local emergency medical service personnel waiting in Forks.

U.S. Coast Guard photo courtesy of Air Station Port Angeles.
